subject: Portal roles, temporary credentials, and proof-of-possession for Cloudflux onboarding
thread_content:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Moran <amoran@cloudflux.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Portal roles, temporary credentials, and proof-of-possession for Cloudflux onboarding

Hi Alicia,

Thanks again for starting the portal onboarding for Cloudflux. Two quick asks from our security intake that will unblock the OneTrust/Vendr profile completion:

1) Role mapping: we need a short list of suggested role mappings (upload-only, evidence-admin, read-only) and the email(s) you plan to assign so we can mirror them in our SSO/SCIM mapping.

2) Temporary upload creds: your portal requires an S3 pre-signed upload flow. To avoid long-lived keys we prefer a temp-credential handshake. Can you confirm whether you accept:
   - short-lived STS credentials (recommended) OR
   - pre-signed multi-part upload URLs

3) Proof-of-possession: for a subset of artifacts (SOC2 attestation PDF, KMS config export) we need a simple signed hash or an attestation file you generate in the portal. We attached a one-page suggested instruction we can host in the portal as guidance.

I've looped in Sean (platform infra) for the technical details and Monica for the evidence intake coordination. Happy to hop on a quick 30m call if helpful.

Best,
Chloe
Chloe Martin
Customer Security Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_proof_of_possession_instructions.pdf (suggested attestation format)

-----
From: Alicia Moran <amoran@cloudflux.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Cc: Cloudflux Onboarding <onboard@cloudflux.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Portal roles, temporary credentials, and proof-of-possession for Cloudflux onboarding

Hi Chloe — thanks for the clear notes. Quick answers below: 

1) Role mapping: we can predefine three roles that match your names:
   - evidence_uploader@cloudflux.com (upload-only)
   - evidence_admin@cloudflux.com (upload + manage)
   - evidence_readonly@cloudflux.com (read-only)
We can also map to your IdP group values via SCIM once you share the group names.

2) Temporary upload creds: we support both approaches. Our preferred (and most secure) option is short-lived STS credentials (15m default) obtained via an on-demand token exchange. Pre-signed multipart URLs are supported but require a separate lifecycle for revocation.

3) Proof-of-possession: we can host your attestation doc as an evidence object. Alternatively we can accept a signed SHA256 manifest file generated by your side. Either is fine — our security team prefers the signed manifest for automation.

I'll schedule a 30m call for Wed morning PT to walk through the SCIM and STS exchange if that works.

Best,
Alicia
Alicia Moran
Security Operations Lead, Cloudflux

-----
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Alicia Moran <amoran@cloudflux.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Portal roles, temporary credentials, and proof-of-possession for Cloudflux onboarding

Thanks Alicia — STS exchange works for us. A couple of implementation notes from the Redwood side:

- We can run a short-lived AWS STS AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity flow from a dedicated service account to upload artifacts into your evidence bucket. We prefer the 15-minute expiry window too.
- For manifest signing: we'll generate a canonical JSON manifest of files uploaded (filename, size, sha256) and sign it using our internal key. If you send the public key fingerprint, we can include the signature as a portal evidence item.
- If you need additional metadata fields in the upload (dataset, environment, evidence_type) tell us the exact field names; we can surface them as S3 object tags or as portal metadata.

I can take lead on the token exchange steps in the Wed call.

- Sean
Principal Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference

-----
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alicia Moran <amoran@cloudflux.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Portal roles, temporary credentials, and proof-of-possession for Cloudflux onboarding

Adding the onboarding checklist (spreadsheet) with the exact artifacts we will upload and suggested portal fields. Alicia — can you confirm the portal field names for:
- evidence_type (SOC2_report / KMS_export / Syslog_zip)
- retention_days
- custodian_email

Also requesting a contact for verification when we submit the signed manifest so we can mark the artifact as "verified" in the checklist.

Thanks,
Monica
Security Intake Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachment: cloudflux_onboarding_checklist.xlsx (rows: artifact, local_path, upload_field_mapping, expected_filename_pattern)

-----
From: Alicia Moran <amoran@cloudflux.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 15:38:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Portal roles, temporary credentials, and proof-of-possession for Cloudflux onboarding

Thanks all — confirming field mappings:
- evidence_type -> evidence_category (allowed values: SOC2_report, KMS_export, syslog_bundle)
- retention_days -> retention_ttl_days (integer)
- custodian_email -> owner_email (string)

For verification, please email evidence-verify@cloudflux.com with the manifest and the signature. I'll be on the verification thread and will sign off once hashes match. Wed 10:30am PT works for our call; I'll send a calendar invite.

Looking forward to the walkthrough.
Alicia

Attachment references: none in this reply.

-- End of thread --
